meta.title: Agent runs that built this site
meta.source: OpenCode session store (local), exported by scripts/telemetry/export_traces.py
notes: One trace per user turn in the five root sessions of the website work; subagent runs nest under the task call that started them.
Times are milliseconds from the start of each trace. Only the calendar day is kept.
An LLM span is one model step, from its start to the start of its last tool call (an estimate of generation time). TOOL spans are the tool executions.

Published fields are structural only: span kind, generic agent name, model id, allowlisted tool name, times, status and token counts. Prompts, responses, reasoning, tool inputs and outputs, file names, commands and titles are not included.
Bash calls carry only a category (test, build, git-commit, git-other, server, other) assigned inside the exporter.
Tools outside the allowlist were dropped entirely (24 spans). Unfinished calls (1) were dropped too.
Cost is omitted: the runs used a flat-rate subscription, so a list-price cost would mislead.
Evaluators are deterministic code checks. There is no LLM-as-judge: the exporter has no model access.

Long runs are compacted for size. Kept as single spans: the first and last 1 steps of each orchestrator run and 0 of each subagent run, every step that delegates or commits, and the first 1 step(s) with an error in each run beyond those. The steps between are merged into CHAIN spans that keep their step, tool-call and token totals. Rollups, trace totals and evaluations use every span before compaction.
Round labels come from commit times in this repository's git history.

evaluators.name: Tool error rate
evaluators.description: Share of tool calls in the trace that returned an error. Fails above 10%.
evaluators.question: Did the agents mostly call their tools correctly?

evaluators.name: Recovered after error
evaluators.description: For every failed tool call, a later call of the same tool in the same trace succeeded. Only scored on traces with an error.
evaluators.question: When a tool call failed, did the agent retry or fix it?

evaluators.name: Delegation used
evaluators.description: The trace contains at least one subagent run (a task call or a subagent session).
evaluators.question: Did the orchestrator hand work to a specialist?

evaluators.name: Review before commit
evaluators.description: A quality-reviewer run finished after the previous commit in the session and before the trace's last commit. Only scored on traces that commit.
evaluators.question: Was the change reviewed before it was saved?

evaluators.name: Tests before commit
evaluators.description: A test command ran after the previous commit in the session and before the trace's last commit. Commands are classified inside the exporter; only the category is published. Only scored on traces that commit.
evaluators.question: Were the tests run before the change was saved?

evaluators.name: Model latency budget
evaluators.description: p90 of model step latency (step start to its last tool call) in the trace is under 30 s.
evaluators.question: Did the model respond quickly enough to keep the loop moving?

evaluators.name: Generated tokens per tool call
evaluators.description: Output plus reasoning tokens divided by tool calls in the trace (a number, not pass/fail). Lower means terser actions.
evaluators.question: How much did the model write for each action it took?
